agent_messages.text: I’ll resume the reviewed P08 repair, check the retained EU authority for applicability, then implement and test both matched bond outcomes. I’ll keep the wider method queue and any unresolved authority visible in the deliverables.

The prior blocker is confirmed: the engine admits only AASB. The EU archive provides the core bond provisions, but reporting scope and amendment applicability still need checking before an EU label can support a comparison. I’m using the unchanged AASB cases and independent cash-flow arithmetic as the baselines.

The reporting-scope regulation was retrieved successfully, and I checked the four retained amendment annexes. The remaining amendment and corrigendum routes returned empty or unavailable responses; the bounded retrieval attempts are complete. EU applicability therefore remains unresolved. I’ll preserve the new findings, add explicit applicability checks to admission, and keep the EU comparison unadmitted.

The EU dossier now records 26 paragraph anchors, four amendment decisions, and the exact unresolved documents. The retained IAS 1 amendment affects presentation: the remaining debt is current at the end of 2024. The new admission path rejects EU treatment while applicability remains unresolved. I’m adding corruption and failed-event tests, then regenerating the deliverables.

I’ll verify the partial P08 work against the current files, then continue the EU comparator repair. I’ll keep source-access limits explicit and reserve time to run the required checks and write the result.

The partial implementation has 33 passing checks, but it still rejects EU admission because applicable amendments and corrigenda remain uninspected. I’ll check the retained source routes and resolve those specific dependencies; the passing checks do not complete the comparison.

The official CELEX metadata route works for an amendment whose PDF request failed. I’ll inspect its document links for an available primary text. In parallel, I’m checking the retained eligibility provisions without changing the bond facts or dates.

The document links supplied twelve missing official texts. Several are EEA incorporation decisions; three financial-instrument amendments first apply in 2026, with early application permitted. I’m recording those distinctions and checking the corrigenda. EU admission still requires the remaining applicability review.
I’ll verify the current EU authority dossier and partial implementation, complete the remaining supported repairs, and run the required checks within the phase budget.

The previous attempt retained the missing EU amendments but timed out before resolving applicability or implementing the comparator. I’m checking those texts against the unchanged bond facts; passing engineering tests alone will not admit the EU treatment.

The retained corrections cover several different subjects. The Dutch correction concerns revenue; the relevant Bulgarian corrections concern offsetting, risk disclosures and asset-side provisions. I’m finishing the reporting-scope checks before building the EU lifecycle and its regime-specific validation.

The inspected 2008 scope amendment changes adoption procedures, and the Polish correction clarifies that listing in any Member State qualifies. The Portuguese correction is still unavailable after the two permitted routes. I’ll keep EU admission blocked, record that dependency precisely, and finish the source-validation repairs and required checks.
